chunks: Whatever was in it from Ziyad ibn Marwan al-Qindi, I have narrated it from my father—may Allah be pleased with him—from Sa'd ibn Abdullah, from Muhammad ibn 'Isa ibn 'Ubayd and Ya'qub ibn Yazid, from Ziyad ibn Marwan al-Qindi.

key_terms.أَبِي: My father; the immediate authority from whom the compiler narrates.
key_terms.رَوَيْتُهُ: I transmitted it; a technical expression of hadith narration.
key_terms.زِيَادِ بْنِ مَرْوَانَ الْقِنْدِيِّ: A narrator whose transmission path is being identified here.
key_terms.سَعْدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: An intermediary narrator in the sanad/isnad.

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain for the narrations of Ziyad ibn Marwan al-Qindi in Man La Yahduruhu al-Faqih?
ai.summary: This passage clarifies the sanad/isnad through which the author transmits reports from Ziyad ibn Marwan al-Qindi. It serves as a technical statement of transmission authority in hadith literature, identifying the intermediaries between the compiler and the named narrator.
